summary: The StudentPreCertifications module in HSPnet enables the management of student certification records through a web-based interface. It features listing, insertion, editing, deletion, and display of certification data for students, with workflows tailored for permissions and system states such as editable/read-only modes.
purpose: To provide authorized users (staff, placing users, QES editors, or students with matching IDs) the ability to view, add, edit, or delete student certification records, enforce validations and business rules, and maintain data integrity and permission logic for certification management.

workflows.name: Certification CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
steps: User accesses the certification list via gridData.
If authorized and screen is editable, user may add (cmdAdd), edit (cmdEdit), or delete (cmdDelete) entries.
Insert: grid command switches FormView to Insert mode; input fields presented.
Edit: grid command switches FormView to Edit mode; pre-fills data.
Delete: grid command deletes record, invokes backend delete logic.
Data is bound to form via dsStudentCertification ObjectDataSource.
FormView handles DataBound events to populate dropdowns and validate permissions.
On saving (cmdSave), Insert or Update is triggered depending on mode.
After insert/update/delete, redirect() is called to refresh the view.

workflows.name: Permission-based Visibility
steps: On grid header or row binding, checks UserSession roles and flags.
Add/Edit/Delete buttons are shown/hidden or enabled/disabled based on permissions.
Rows are hidden if user lacks view permission.
Only DisclosedRegistrationCodeID rows are shown for ITProvisioning users.

business_rules: Only authorized users can add, edit, or delete certification records.
DisclosedRegistrationCodeID is used to filter shown records for ITProvisioning.
No certification data is shown to users without appropriate role or anonymous access.
Dropdown controls are pre-populated and blank entries can be inserted.
validations: Page.IsValid checks before insert and update; cancels event if invalid.
Dropdown values for CertificationCodeID and StatusCodeID must be selected.
EffectiveDate and ExpiryDate controls validate input and respect MaxDate (future year limit).
calculations: MaxDate for date fields is calculated as DateTime.Now plus maximum allowed future years (per configuration).
conditions: Anonymous disables buttons and hides rows.
UserSession roles (PlacingUser, StudentMaint, QESEdit, StudentUser, ITProvisioning) affect visibility and actions.
FormViewMode (Insert or Edit) determines template and command.
system_behavior: Uses AJAX UpdatePanels for partial page updates (updPnlMain, updPnlPopup).
ModalPopupExtender provides popup for certification details.
FormView and GridView facilitate data entry and listing.
ObjectDataSources (dsStudentCertification, dsStdCertifications, dsStatus, dsExpiryDate) bind certification data from backend.
Redirect on successful insert/update/delete to refresh data.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, ObjectDataSourceSelecting is canceled.
Invalid input cancels FormView events and prevents database action.
content_gaps: Business logic details for StudentCertification data persistence and backend validation are not fully described.
Exception handling for database and UI errors is not detailed.
Exact UI templates/layouts and dropdown values are not specified.
